Swiss Pro Map is the map app for Switzerland: offline maps and useful functions for outdoor activities such as mountain sports, hiking, cycling and aviation.

Maps such as the Swiss National Map, as well as objects on the map, such as hiking trails, public transport stops incl. timetable, SAC huts, parking spaces, location descriptions and much more, once loaded, remain usable offline on the device.
The app supports important functions for outdoor activities such as altitude display, distance and area measurement, search for locations and coordinates, route recording, import and export, offline route planning, etc. 

Swiss Pro Map is free for two weeks from installation. After that, a subscription is required for unlimited use:

* The subscription enables unlimited use of the app and finances its maintenance and further development.

Routiq in a nutshell:
• Find thousands of free cycling and walking routes
• Create your own cycling and walking routes with the route planner
• Navigate walking and cycling routes with spoken instructions
• Including cycling and walking nodes
• Over 2,500,000 downloads already!

With Premium you get the following extras:
• Spoken (step-by-step) navigation instructions
• Save unlimited routes
• Download routes for offline use, no internet required
• Share your own routes with friends
• Link to Apple's Health app

The Routiq app is very user-friendly for recreational cyclists and walkers. Finding or creating a route is done in no time. In addition, you can navigate carefree with the app so that you can fully enjoy the environment.

• Create a Route •
Plan your own route from your home address via nodes and self-made (intermediate) points. Click on the route planner symbol and start a route by pressing a node or by placing your own waypoint on the map with your finger. Then you can add nodes or your own waypoints. As a Premium member you can save unlimited routes.

• Find a Route •
There are more than 150,000 cycling and walking routes in the app that you can choose from. Of course you can also choose from a cycling and walking route in your area. Have you found a nice route? Then mark it as a favorite and find the route easily that way.

• Navigate the Route •
Have you found or made a route? Press Start Navigation and experience the pleasure of the 3D view and spoken route instructions. The app now also shows distance to the end point, calories burned and much more.

• Premium Membership •
After all, there is more to discover when you don't have to pay as much attention to the route.
Optionally, Routiq offers a Premium membership for €9.99 per year. Premium includes: Walking & Cycling navigation - Save unlimited routes - Share your own routes with friends - Navigate even when you don't have internet for a while.

The purchase will be charged to your iTunes account. You can change or cancel your subscription at any time using your Apple ID in iTunes. The subscription is automatically renewed 24 hours before the end of the subscription with the same subscription for the same price. It is not possible to cancel the subscription while it is active. Notams Aero is the best NOTAM application. 

You can see NOTAMs on the map. Each NOTAM is displayed in categorized colors. Red means firing, yellow means training, blue means UAV, green means parachute etc. Additionally; each NOTAM area has a symbol which describes its subject ( for instance; you will see a remote control symbol for UAV NOTAM area)

* Flight recording and exporting of this as KML file
* Airport/Aerodrome meteorological information (METAR & TAF) 
* Airport/Aerodrome NOTAMs 
* Altitude filtering for NOTAMs
* All defined areas (prohibited areas, restricted areas, CTR, TMA, TRA, TSA, CBA etc) 
* Airports, heliports and other aeronautical points with their detailed information
